rulings.name: [Errata #5] Runechant/Quicken - trigger on activate
rulings.description: This card's textbox was updated to change a effect to trigger on the activation of a weapon attack rather than when the weapon becomes attacking, so that would be consistent in trigger timing with playing an attack action card.
